attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Array of bank account objects to create in bulk

attributes.name: ReferenceId
attributes.description: Transient unique ID assigned by the developer. Used to reference individual bank accounts in the bulk-creation process.

attributes.name: AccountNumber
attributes.description: Account number of the bank account

attributes.name: AccountName
attributes.description: The user-provided name for the bank account

attributes.name: BankName
attributes.description: Name of the bank associated with the bank account

attributes.name: RoutingNumber
attributes.description: The routing number of the bank associated with the bank account

attributes.name: BankAddress1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the bank associated with the bank account

attributes.name: BankCity
attributes.description: The city where the bank associated with the bank account is located

attributes.name: NextCheckNumber
attributes.description: The number checks for this bank account should start at. Must be a positive integer (not zero)

attributes.name: BankAddress2
attributes.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the bank associated with the bank account

attributes.name: BankState
attributes.description: The state where the bank associated with the bank account is located

attributes.name: BankZip
attributes.description: The zip code where the bank associated with the bank account is located

attributes.name: CompanyAddress1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the company. Will be printed on any blank checkstock

attributes.name: CompanyAddress2
attributes.description: Additional street address information of the company

attributes.name: CompanyCity
attributes.description: The city where the company is located. Must be provided if entering a company address

attributes.name: CompanyState
attributes.description: The state where the company is located. Must be provided if entering a company address

attributes.name: CompanyZip
attributes.description: The zip code where the company is located. Must be provided if entering a company address

attributes.name: CompanyNameOnChecks
attributes.description: The company name printed on checks issued from this bank account

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of results for each bank account creation attempt

responseFields.name: data[].ReferenceId
responseFields.description: Transient unique ID assigned by the developer. Used to reference individual bank accounts in the bulk-creation process.

responseFields.name: data[].BankAccountId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the created bank account
